_doc: P304 in-session adjudication of each AWARDED centrifuge finding vs the COLD-surfaced set. Mechanism-based, P287/P295 vocabulary; key not seen before discovery froze. P303-class annotations included.

M-01.evidence: Awarded: Axelar Router onlyCentrifugeChainOrigin can't verify msg.sender==axelarGateway. Surfaced CC-01 flagged the inbound cross-chain message-auth/router-trust subsystem (Gateway.handle/incomingRouters) generically, but not the specific Axelar Router modifier bug (axelar/Router.sol was not deep-read). Same subsystem, different contract/mechanism.

M-02.evidence: Awarded: requestRedeemWithPermit can be front-run via a different liquidity pool (permit not bound to pool). Surfaced flagged the SAME functions (requestDeposit/RedeemWithPermit) but for the non-standard-permit-DoS mechanism (P303 class), not the cross-pool front-run. Same locus, different mechanism. P303 permit-class awareness is why the permit functions were flagged at all.

M-03.evidence: Cached DOMAIN_SEPARATOR computed at ERC20 construction with the (then-empty) tranche name, which is set later via file('name') -> permit digest mismatch. Not surfaced: a cross-contract EIP-712 lifecycle bug (token name set post-deploy). New class.

M-04.evidence: Griefing: depositing a tiny amount for another user to DoS their claim. Not surfaced: a deposit-for-others griefing/DoS mechanism. New class.

M-05.evidence: Awarded: claiming maxDeposit via deposit() can leave other investors unable to claim their maxDeposit/maxMint (shared-escrow / per-user orderbook depletion). Surfaced examined the processDeposit/orderbook/escrow flow (and flagged convert/price issues there) but did not name the cross-user shared-escrow depletion. Same subsystem, mechanism not isolated.

M-06.evidence: DelayedAdmin cannot call PauseAdmin.removePauser (admin wiring/permission gap). Not surfaced: admins/DelayedAdmin.sol + PauseAdmin.sol were not deep-read. New class (admin wiring).

M-07.evidence: Awarded: trancheTokenAmount should be rounded UP on withdraw/previewWithdraw (currently Rounding.Down everywhere). Surfaced AR-01 flagged the same _calculate*/price-decimal math but for an overflow mechanism, not the rounding-direction bug. Same functions, different mechanism.

M-08.evidence: Awarded: RestrictionManager does not fully implement ERC1404 -> restricted accounts retain access. Surfaced DT-04/LG-01: detectTransferRestriction only checks hasMember(to) (no sender gating) and members cannot be immediately frozen. Same root cause and locus.
